name: Regal Zephyr
description: The Regal Zephyr was a passenger transport operated by Regal Voyager along the Ootmian Pabol hyperspace route during the Republic Era. The transport was the site of an attempted hijacking by a group of criminals—The Lobber, Ghor, and Wungo—but the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan, Obi-Wan Kenobi, who had been traveling aboard the Regal Zephyr to Coruscant, intervened.
